Litigation Hold Notice — RIF 2026
Sent Aug 22, 2026 · via Email · 342 of 345 delivered
Added in this version

Dear [Custodian Name],

You are receiving this notice because you may have documents, communications, or other information relevant to Board Matter 2026-04 (the "Matter"). Effective immediately, you are required to preserve all potentially relevant materials in your possession or control, including but not limited to emails, instant messages, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and any files belonging to the 12 additional Sales team members added after the department reorg, until you are notified that this hold has been released.

This notice has been amended to add 12 additional Sales team custodians identified after the department reorganization completed on August 21, 2026. If you have already deleted any materials related to this Matter prior to this date, please contact the Legal department immediately.

Please do not delete, modify, or otherwise dispose of any such materials. If you have questions about the scope of this hold, contact the Legal department.

You will be asked to confirm receipt of this notice.

Regards,
J. Ward
Legal Department
